name: Free and private AI Notetaker
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 We built Bookipi AI Notetaker because we wanted a meeting notetaker that’s free, local and private, and actually nice to use. The ones we tried either sent everything to the cloud or felt clunky, so we made our own. 💸 Free. There’s no subscription and no limits on meetings. You get every feature without paying anything. 💻 Local. Recording, transcription and summaries all happen on your device. No bot joins your call, and you don’t have to upload anything. 🔒 Private.
